item.text: The TTK simplification ran successfully on all three frames at an absolute persistence threshold of 0.5. I also computed 25 simplified local maxima per frame and used POT’s exact EMD transport plans for the two inter-frame correspondences.

Completed the ParaView/TTK/POT workflow.

- Persistence simplification threshold: 0.5 (absolute), applied to frames 1–3.
- Piecewise-linear maxima: 25 per frame.
- Temporal association: exact Earth Mover’s Distance transport via POT.
- Markers: sphere radius 2.
- Scalar field: warm–cold color map.
